title: 367. Paint House II

examples.explanation: Paint house 0 with color 0 (1) and house 1 with color 2 (4) for 1 + 4 = 5.
Either 1 + 4 or 3 + 2 gives 5 while keeping neighbors different.
With one house, pick the cheapest of its colors.

hints: For each house, only the smallest and second-smallest totals from the previous house matter.
A color reuses the smallest previous total unless it used the same color, in which case it falls back to the second smallest.
